marie(sec): Auditor requested a concise evidence bundle mapping our RBAC change process to SOC2/ISO controls plus KMS rotation/unseal events for the past 24 months. Can we scope artifacts and an ETA? @dan(infra) @ron(eng)

dan(infra): Scope ack. Deliverables: 1) control-mapping (1 page), 2) RBAC PR list + review screenshots, 3) rolebinding diffs + sample CI logs, 4) KMS metadata export (no key material), 5) emergency access attestation. ETA: 36 hours for full package.

ron(eng): For CI proof I'll include a job excerpt showing the staged role test. Example:
```
# ci excerpt
kubectl apply -f ci/rolebanding-test.yaml --dry-run=server
kubectl auth can-i create configmaps --as=system:serviceaccount:team:deploy:ci
```
I'll also add `git log --pretty=oneline -- rolebindings/` output.

auditor_claire: Please ensure the KMS export shows CreateDate, RotationStatus, LastUsed, and any manual Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls with approver identity. We need a human-signed attestation for any manual unwraps. Redaction is fine but map internal ids to names in a separate protected file.

marie(sec): Agreed on redaction. No plaintext key material. We'll include `redaction-map.csv` and `redaction-manifest.txt`. I'll prepare the attestation (GPG-signed) referencing ticket SEC-2026-211.

dan(infra): Splunk/Kusto query I'll run for KMS events: `index=kms_logs action IN (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt) | table _time, user, keyId, action, requestParameters` then export gzipped JSON and a CSV slice for reviewer. Note: we'll replace full ARNs with `user:XXXX` tokens in the exported files.

ron(eng): Also include the PR links for service-account changes and the branch-protection/CODEOWNERS snapshot to show required reviewers. I'll add short screenshots of review approvals (redacted comments).

auditor_claire: Also include a short vuln triage note if there were any KMS-related CVEs in scope. One paragraph is enough: CVE id, status, PR link, and mitigations.

dan(infra): We're tracking CVE-2026-9999 in kms-helper; PR merged to staging (PR #4901), prod rollout scheduled. I'll add triage/ folder with timeline and compensating controls (eg network restrictions).

evidence-bot: evidence: package job started by @dan(infra) (job id: ev-pack-183333) - generating manifest and checksums.

marie(sec): Action items: marie -> attestation + control-mapping doc; dan -> KMS exports + manifest; ron -> RBAC PR list + CI snippets; I'll review final manifest before upload.

auditor_claire: ETA 36h works. Please drop the presigned link here when ready for review. Thanks. :thumbsup:

marie(sec): Thanks everyone. Ping me immediately if you hit a blocker.
